The derivative gain kd is slightly reduced from 0.5 to 0.4 to try to lower steering oscillation, which was moderate (~0.25) previously. The integral gain ki remains at 0.2, consistent with the prior reduction to reduce overshoot. The line_loss strategy remains 'search_left' as before, which was chosen to improve line recovery. Sensor weights and geometry are unchanged to isolate controller effects. Since no finishes have occurred yet, this candidate aims to push progress further while controlling oscillations. Depending on the next race results, if line loss events remain at 1.0 or progress is still low, consider experimenting with sensor_weights to improve signal quality or adjusting ki slightly to balance stability and responsiveness. If steering oscillation remains high, further reduce kd or try alternative line_loss strategies such as 'search_right' or 'last_direction'. If progress improves but off-track failures persist, consider tuning sensor positions or wheel_track to improve stability.
